Grounding note: I checked the service blueprint under `Pre-session` › `Session Prep & Resources` just now (`matchedBy: vector`, where current cells like [`c1000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000035`](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=c1000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000035) cover assigning internal repository resources via `/PLUS/Resources`); a dedicated external link shelf shared directly between an assigned tutor and student is a new touchpoint.

***

# Prompt-Spec: Tutor Resource Shelf (Low-Fi Wireframe Flow)

## 1. Flow Overview
* **Trigger:** A tutor wants to assemble curated study links for an assigned student ahead of or following a session.
* **Steps:**
  1. Tutor navigates to the shelf editor, names the shelf (or edits an existing name), adds web links with titles and URLs, and triggers sharing.
  2. The assigned student accesses the shared shelf view.
  3. The student reviews the link collection and selects an external link to launch the study resource.
* **Outcome:** The student accesses curated study materials; the tutor retains management (add/remove links) of the active shelf.

## 2. Actors & Surfaces
* **Actors:**
  * `Regular Tutor` (author, curator, editor)
  * `Student` (consumer, viewer)
* **Surfaces:**
  * Screen A: **Tutor Shelf Editor** (desktop / tablet viewport, wireframe level)
  * Screen B: **Student Shelf View** (desktop / mobile responsive wireframe)

## 3. Scope & Boundaries
* **In Scope:**
  * Shelf title editing and display.
  * Adding a link (URL + display title) and removing existing links.
  * Explicit share trigger action.
  * Student view displaying shelf title, tutor attribution, and actionable resource links.
  * Low-fi wireframe aesthetics: grayscale, clear typographic hierarchy, structural wireframe containers, standard form elements.
* **Explicitly Out of Scope (Do Not Generate):**
  * Resource ratings, likes, or student commenting.
  * Multi-tutor collaborative editing.
  * Global resource marketplace or search directories.
  * Student login/authentication screens and session room embedding.

---

## 4. Screen Specifications

### Screen A: Tutor Shelf Editor

#### Layout & Hierarchy
* **Header Bar:** Breadcrumb navigation ("Student Profile › Resources › Edit Shelf") and page title ("Resource Shelf Editor").
* **Shelf Identity Section:**
  * Text input: `Shelf Title` (Placeholder: *"e.g., Algebra II Midterm Prep"*).
  * Subtitle / Metadata: *"Visible to: [Student Name]"*.
* **Link Builder Form:**
  * Input field 1: `Resource Title` (Label: *"Resource Name"*, Placeholder: *"e.g., Desmos Graphing Calculator"*).
  * Input field 2: `URL` (Label: *"Link URL"*, Placeholder: *"https://..."*).
  * Primary Button: `Add Link`.
* **Current Links List (Table / Card Stack):**
  * List items displaying: Link icon indicator, Resource Name, destination domain URL, and a `Remove` text button per item.
* **Footer Actions:**
  * Secondary button: `Save Draft`.
  * Primary action button: `Share Shelf with Student` *(See Open Decision 1 for delivery mechanism)*.

#### Screen States
* **Default / Populated State:**
  * Shelf Title: `"Algebra II Functions & Graphing"`
  * Item 1: Title: `"Khan Academy: Linear Function Graphs"` · URL: `"https://khanacademy.org/math/algebra/..."` · Action: `[Remove]`
  * Item 2: Title: `"Desmos Interactive Calculator"` · URL: `"https://desmos.com/calculator"` · Action: `[Remove]`
  * Item 3: Title: `"Unit 3 Practice Problem Set (PDF)"` · URL: `"https://drive.google.com/file/d/..."` · Action: `[Remove]`
* **Empty State (Link List):**
  * Bounded wireframe box showing:
    * Headline: `"No resources added yet"`
    * Body copy: `"Add your first study link above to build this shelf for [Student Name]."`
    * Disabled button: `Share Shelf with Student` (inactive until at least 1 link exists).
* **Error States:**
  * *Empty Title on Submit:* Inline error below Shelf Title: `"Please provide a name for this shelf before sharing."`
  * *Malformed URL:* Inline error below Link URL: `"Please enter a valid web address starting with http:// or https://"`

---

### Screen B: Student Shelf View

#### Layout & Hierarchy
* **Header / Hero:**
  * Display Heading: `[Shelf Title]` (H1 wireframe block).
  * Subtitle: `"Curated by Tutor [Tutor Name]"` · Timestamp: `"Updated [Date]"`.
* **Resource Collection (Card Grid / Stack):**
  * Clean wireframe cards containing:
    * Resource title (large, clickable link styling).
    * Destination domain snippet (e.g., `khanacademy.org`).
    * External launch indicator icon (`↗`).
* **Secondary / Help Area:**
  * Caption text: `"Need an additional resource? Discuss during your next scheduled PLUS session."`

#### Screen States
* **Default Populated State:**
  * Matches links from Screen A (`"Khan Academy: Linear Function Graphs"`, `"Desmos Interactive Calculator"`, etc.). Clicking any card or link triggers an external browser window.
* **Empty State:**
  * Wireframe placeholder card:
    * Headline: `"Your resource shelf is currently empty"`
    * Body text: `"Your tutor hasn't added any study links yet. Check back after your session."`

---

## 5. Unresolved Edge Decisions (Gaps Held Open)
*Per method §3 & §4, these hand-off mechanisms are not settled in the PRD. The screens reserve the layout slot but do not invent arbitrary mechanisms:*
1. **Student Handoff / Notification Mechanism:** How does the student discover that a shelf has been created or updated? (Slot in UI reserved as open question: In-app notification badge, dashboard card, or session chat link?).
2. **Real-Time Collision / Concurrency:** What happens if the student has the shelf open when the tutor removes a link? (Open question: Silent removal on page refresh vs. live socket removal).
3. **Draft vs. Live State:** Does "Share" make edits instantly live, or does the editor maintain an unpublished draft state?

---

## 6. Embedded Self-Check Block
```markdown
[STITCH_SELF_CHECK]
1. Goal: Enables a tutor to curate/manage links and an assigned student to view/follow them. (PASS/FAIL)
2. Fidelity: Low-fi wireframe strictly honored (grayscale, boxes, cross-hatches, standard input fields; NO high-fidelity branding or stylized illustrations). (PASS/FAIL)
3. Copy: Zero placeholder/lorem ipsum; all titles, URLs, and labels reflect real tutoring domain data. (PASS/FAIL)
4. States Included: Empty list, populated list, validation error states for both screens. (PASS/FAIL)
5. Out of Scope: No social features, student feedback forms, or cross-tutor libraries generated. (PASS/FAIL)
6. Edges: Does not invent speculative notification banners or complex socket badges for the student handoff. (PASS/FAIL)

*Instruction to generator:* If any check fails, regenerate once to correct layout, copy, or state omissions before completing.
```

***

**Artifact manifest:**
`low-fi · Stitch · inline PRD (Tutor resource shelf) · unresolved checks: none (3 edge decisions held open per §4)`
